name: BeastMaster
description: BeastMaster chronicles the adventures of Dar, the last surviving male of the storied Sula tribe, who is blessed with the ability to communicate telepathically with the animals of his ancient world. Also endowed with the strength, courage and fighting skills of a great warrior, he uses his gifts to defend all living creatures oppressed by the forces of evil.

videos.title: The Beastmaster
videos.overview: The movie that inspired two sequels and a TV series. The Beastmaster tells the story of Dar (Marc Singer), the royal son of a king named Zed (Rod Loomis) who was stolen from the womb of Zed's queen (Vanna Bonta) by a witch under the command of vicious high-priest sorcerer Maax (Rip Torn). A poor villager saves Dar from being sacrificed and raises him as his own son, teaching Dar how to fight and witnessing the boy's ability to telepathically communicate with animals. Their happiness is destroyed when their village is attacked by the evil Jun horde, a race of fanatic beast-like warriors controlled by Maax. Dar, the only survivor of the attack, vows revenge and journeys to his father's former kingdom to destroy Maax.

videos.title: The Legend Continues
videos.overview: Dar befriends inquisitive and bumbling Tao as he begins his quest to rescue his long-lost love Kyra, who has been kidnapped and enslaved by the brutal Terron warriors.

videos.title: Obsession
videos.overview: Dar teams up with Akili, a warrior banished by the Terrons, to rescue his beloved Kyra, unaware that Akili is also in love with her.

videos.title: The Island
videos.overview: With the help of his animal friends, Dar rescues Tao from an island inhabited by the murderous Birdmen.

videos.title: A Simple Truth
videos.overview: After finally being reunited with Dar, Kyra is captured by the Sorceress.

videos.title: Amazons
videos.overview: Dar races to retrieve a rare fire lily from a valley inhabited by Amazons to save the life of a young woman, Maleena.

videos.title: The Demon Curupira
videos.overview: Dar and a young boy, Guariba, convince the Demon Curupira to spare the lives of Guariba's tribe -- if the tribe agrees to show respect for the land and inhabitants of the rain forest.

videos.title: The Umpatra
videos.overview: Dar must summon all of his skills to end the killing rampage of the world's greatest warrior Nokinja, who is secretly backed by the magic of the evil demon Ketzwayo, Curupira's sworn enemy.

videos.title: The Last Unicorns
videos.overview: Dar and Tao must save the Princess's Unicorns from the Terrons, who want to kill the Unicorns fro their horns which hold magical healing powers.

videos.title: Circle of Life
videos.overview: At the Black Apparition's behest, Ketzwayo returns from the dead with magic designed to kill Dar and the entire animal kingdom of the Mydlands.

videos.title: Riddle of the Nymph
videos.overview: Dar and Tao have to rescue a Nymph who persades people to drink the water which brings eternal youth from a Venatu warrior.

videos.title: Valhalla
videos.overview: Guided by a magical Shaman, Dar retuns to Valhalla, a place of memories to come to terms with the destrctive slaughter of his tribe.

videos.title: The Slayer
videos.overview: In a test for his love for Kyra, Dar finds himself taking a liking to Zuraya , a animal trainer cursed by loneliness from Ancient One.

videos.title: The Minotaur
videos.overview: Dar reluctantly accepts help from the Sorceress to rescue Tao from King Zad's ferocious Minotaur.

videos.title: The Guardian
videos.overview: Dar and Tao must stop an unholy pilgrim named Ramah, who gains possession of a liquid rock that gives him control over life and death.

videos.title: The Chameleon
videos.overview: Dar and Tao must protect a mystical baby from the evil King Zad, who believes the child will bring about his demise.

videos.title: A Devil's Deal
videos.overview: Dar meets a strange amphibious woman named Atlantia who is part of an mute ancient race. He must communicate with her and then gain her help to save Tao's life.

videos.title: Tears of the Sea
videos.overview: While trying to expose a young friend's killer, Dar learns that ancestral protectors of a tribe of divers take the form of dolphins in the sea.

videos.title: The Burning Forest
videos.overview: When the Sorceress is captured by the Black Apparition, Sharak in human form enlists Dar's help to save her.

videos.title: The Golden Phoenix
videos.overview: The Golden Phoenix takes the human form of Prince Garuda to exact revenge on Dar.

videos.title: Gemini
videos.overview: Dar and Tao must discover what is killing both humans and animals in the forest before they become the next victims.

videos.title: Rescue
videos.overview: When Dar and Tao learn that the Terrons are holding Kyra Captive once again, the two set out to rescue her.

videos.title: Revelations
videos.overview: Qord vows to kill the BeastMaster and capture Kyra as his ultimate revenge against King Zad.

videos.title: Manlinks
videos.overview: When two new races enter the Territories, Dar and Tao get caught up in the struggle as these groups challenge Zad and his Terrons for supremacy.

videos.title: Iara
videos.overview: Dar and Tao search for missing men on an island inhabited by the deadly serpent demon Iara and a colony of strange and exotic women.

videos.title: Seer
videos.overview: Dar protects Olwen, a Seer pursued by Arina and the Terrons who plan to exploit her powers for their own selfish purposes.

videos.title: Orpheo
videos.overview: Arina's lover returns from beyond the grave and wants to take her back with him.

videos.title: Xinca
videos.overview: Tao's life is threatened when he returns to his homeland of Xinca. Elsewhere, the warrior-guide Arina leads the Nords in an attack against the Terrons.

videos.title: Ghosts of the Forest
videos.overview: It takes the determined spirit of a dying tiger to help Tao recognize a new purpose in his own life.

videos.title: Rage
videos.overview: Dar and Tao prove that communication can be a powerful weapon when they become involved in the Royal Family's bitter dispute.

videos.title: White Tiger
videos.overview: The BeastMaster is stalked by the evil demon, Iara, who plots to win him for herself.

videos.title: Heart Like a Lion
videos.overview: Dar goes to battle to save an entire village from the forces of the evil despot, Arkon.

videos.title: Gone
videos.overview: The BeastMaster intervenes to save a rare Tasmanian tiger from extinction, while Voden attempts to manipulate Dar into helping him expand his empire.

videos.title: Golgotha
videos.overview: Dar fights to restore the balance of nature when a village starts losing young women to the river's starving crocodiles.

videos.title: Tao's Brother
videos.overview: An Eiron leader emerges to reclaim Tao's homeland of Xinca from the evil Blood Priests.

videos.title: Wild Child
videos.overview: Dar vows to reunite Huna with her long lost child, raised from infancy by wolves, and now hunted by the murderous Milos.

videos.title: Mate for Life
videos.overview: Dar helps the young Lyca escape the tyranny of the tribe of lion people.

videos.title: Centaurs
videos.overview: Dar helps Sagitto and Radia, centaur archers forced from the safety of their homeland.

videos.title: Fifth Element
videos.overview: Dar and Tao must save the world from destruction when the evil Annubis is accidentally released from his rock prison.

videos.title: A Terrible Silence
videos.overview: Iara strips Dar of his power to communicate with animals, and unwittingly sets all of nature off balance.

videos.title: Birds
videos.overview: Dar must right an imbalance of nature when the birds of the forest suddenly turn against humans.

videos.title: Mydoro
videos.overview: The BeastMaster must intervene to prevent the Eirons' miraculous healing crystal from falling into the hands of the malevolent King Voden.

videos.title: Game of Death
videos.overview: Dar infiltrates the city of Chalka to free the sacred tigers and release Queen Lyoka from her inner turmoil.

videos.title: Regeneration
videos.overview: Arina must seek Dar's help when she is pursued by The Apparition who is after her unborn child, and by Voden who desires her mare's foal.

videos.title: Clash of the Titans
videos.overview: Dar is drawn into a battle between King Zad and King Voden in order to save Tao, Arina and a band of captured elephants.

videos.title: Legend Reborn
videos.overview: Guided by his spirit warrior, Dartanus, Dar sets out on a journey to discover his true destiny.

videos.title: Crystal Ark
videos.overview: Dar embarks on a journey to discover his true heritage.

videos.title: Chosen One
videos.overview: Dar sets out on a quest to find his family and defeat Balcifer, the Lord of Darkness.

videos.title: Veil of Death
videos.overview: Dar protects a white tiger, which embodies his long lost sister, Lycia.

videos.title: Prize
videos.overview: The Sorceress and the Apparition vie for the evil Balcifer's favor by trying to corrupt Dar.

videos.title: Tiger Tiger
videos.overview: Dar must race to rescue Ruh before he is sacrificed in a grisly ritual meant to earn the favor of Balcifer.

videos.title: Slayer's Return
videos.overview: Dar embarks on a mission to save a wolf named Slayer and destroy King Rolan, a grotesque ancient monster who seeks rebirth through Zuraya's child.

videos.title: Destiny
videos.overview: Dar sneaks into Xinca to rescue an extraordinary horse, despite a fortune-teller's warning that this will lead to Dar's own death.

videos.title: Serpent's Kiss
videos.overview: King Zad finds an ally in Nadeea, a beautiful succubus who will stop at nothing to destroy the BeastMaster.

videos.title: Dispossessed
videos.overview: Dar helps the Orlas reclaim their decimated land, sacrificing his own chance to find his mother.

videos.title: Turning Point
videos.overview: Dar loses heart and considers giving up his quest after leading Arina into a deadly trap.

videos.title: The Hunter
videos.overview: Zad needs Dar's help to stop the evil spirit of a ruthless ruler who is murdering the citizens of Xinca.

videos.title: Turned To Stone
videos.overview: Determined to rescue his brother, Dar risks death to fulfill three daunting tasks for the spiteful demon Yamira.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: The Sorceress, yearning for her love, Sharak, to be returned to his human form, makes a deal with the devil which threatens Dar's quest.

videos.title: Sisters
videos.overview: Dar discovers that the key to his quest lies hidden away in the archives of the legendary Order of Vella.

videos.title: The Alliance
videos.overview: Dar faces an arranged marriage according to an alliance forged by his father, King Eldar.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: Accused of evading his promise to protect the animals, Dar is brought to trial by Curupira's sister, the powerful nature demon, Manaka.

videos.title: The Devil You Know
videos.overview: Callista vows to win the favor of Balcifer by convincing Dar's brother, Sendar, to stake his claim on Eldar's throne.

videos.title: Double Edged
videos.overview: King Zad learns the identity of the sword maker who forged the Sword of Eldar, and orders him to make a Sword of Balcifer.

videos.title: Rites of Passage
videos.overview: Dar faces his biggest test yet in his struggle to defeat the Lord of Darkness.

videos.title: End Game
videos.overview: Dar receives three hidden signals, indicating that the final challenge of his quest is about to begin.

videos.title: A New Dawn
videos.overview: With his entire family inside the Crystal Ark, Dar is faced with his final challenge.
